text:
morgan: deploy-bot flagged canary. p95 up 1.6x, errors 2.3% on canary. auto-rollback threshold tripped.

deploy-bot: AUTO-ROLLBACK RECOMMENDATION: error_rate=2.3% (threshold 2.0%), p95_latency=1250ms (threshold 1200ms). Suggested action: auto-rollback to rollouts/v3.4.1.ETA 60s.

lee: ...we have eu-dedicated customers on this canary slice. not comfortable auto-rollback without confirming.

anya: any matching logs? is it user-facing or inference internal failures?

samir: looking at logs -> most 500s are kvcache misses + OOM retries on a kv worker.

morgan: thanks. suppressing auto-rollback for now. i'm taking manual control. @deploy-bot suppress-auto-rollout by morgan

ops-bridge-bot: ACTION: auto-rollback suppressed by morgan. escalation required for manual rollback. Reason: dedicated-customer impact risk.

kate: fine. propose manual partial revert: revert traffic slice for eu region (10% -> 0%), keep rest of canary. gives time to patch kvcache.

lee: +1. we need customer comms if we reduce capacity. who owns release notes/notify?

morgan: @anya draft short note for dedicated customers: "observed elevated errors in EU canary, rolling back EU slice to previous stable while we investigate. No customer data was affected." Keep it brief.

anya: on it. I'll post in #customer-success and ping account leads. Draft:

```
We observed transient errors affecting inference for a subset of EU traffic following today's rollout. We're reverting that traffic slice to the prior stable model (v3.4.1) to restore normal service and to investigate. No data exposure. ETA 30m for completion. - Red Team
```

samir: ops steps to execute manual partial rollback:
1) pin routes: `redwood routes pin --region eu --model v3.4.1 --slice eu-canary`
2) initiate traffic shift: `redwood rollout adjust --slice eu-canary --traffic 0`
3) monitor p95/errors for 10m
4) if stable, close incident and unpin

morgan: executing step1 now.

morgan: `> redwood routes pin --region eu --model v3.4.1 --slice eu-canary`
deploy-bot: ROUTES PINNED: eu-canary -> v3.4.1 by morgan

morgan: shifting traffic to 0%

morgan: `> redwood rollout adjust --slice eu-canary --traffic 0`

deploy-bot: TRAFFIC UPDATE: eu-canary traffic now 0% (was 10%). Rolling over 120s.

samir: monitoring... p95 down to 600ms, errors 0.5% after shift.

lee: looks stable. if metrics hold for 10m we can mark resolved and unpin.

anya: cust note posted to #customer-success and messaging sent to AEs.

morgan: marking incident as mitigated. keeping pin for 1h to avoid thrashing, then we'll unpin.

ops-bridge-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED: eu-canary rollback completed. Summary: manual partial rollback executed by morgan; metrics returned to baseline. Next: postmortem to include kvcache memory regression root cause. Owner: samir.

morgan: thanks team. follow-up: add auto-rollback suppression rule for dedicated-region slices to avoid automatic flips without human review.

lee: opened ticket: RD-7892 "suppression rule for dedicated-region auto-rollback". assign infra.

samir: noted. starting postmortem draft.

morgan: good job. :thumbsup:
